summary: Guidance for preventing duplicate tool/function invocations across SDK retries and streaming reconnects
description: Issue summary: Customer reports repeated invocation of downstream tools when the SDK retries requests or when a streaming connection is re-established. Impact: Duplicate side effects observed (duplicate order creation calls to a downstream billing service). Customer wants deterministic guidance to achieve exactly-once or at-least-once semantics.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Using Python SDK v0.8.3, call chat.completions with function_call set to 'create_invoice' and no idempotency key in headers.
2) Induce a transient 503 from the gateway (we simulated network blip) to trigger SDK automatic retry after 1s backoff.
3) Observe the downstream billing service received two create_invoice POSTs with different request_ids.
4) Repeat with Typescript SDK v0.9.0 and observe duplicate calls on websocket reconnect when using streaming=true and reconnect logic in app code.
logs: [2026-03-10T14:02:11Z] gateway: 503 transient upstream error, connection dropped
[2026-03-10T14:05:40Z] ts-client: streaming reconnect after socket close, resends function_call payload without idempotency metadata
comments: Support (Maya): Thanks for the report — can you confirm whether you are sending any idempotency header or correlation id with your function calls? Also which SDKs and versions?

Customer (LexaHealth - Jenna R): We are not setting an idempotency header inside the function_call payload. Using Python SDK 0.8.3 in backend and typescript client 0.9.0 in UI. Duplicates are causing double billing for test invoices.

Support (Carlos): Reproduced locally using your sequence. Root cause appears to be retries from the client library combined with gateway transient errors and streaming reconnects that resend the same logical function invocation with new request identifiers.

SRE (Liam): Gateway doesn't currently de-duplicate function invocations consistently for requests without explicit idempotency metadata. There's a partial safeguard for REST sync calls when an idempotency key header is present but not for streamed reconnect sequences.

Support (Maya): Recommended workaround: attach an application-level idempotency key (e.g., invoice_transaction_id) in both the model input and a custom header 'X-Redwood-Idempotency' before we ship a server-side gateway dedupe fix. Asked customer to validate.
Customer (Jenna R): Implemented header and client-side dedupe; duplicates stopped in test environment. Please advise on long-term fix and SDK guidance.
investigation_notes: Hypothesis: Missing idempotency metadata + client automatic retry leads to at-least-once side effects when function_call triggers downstream stateful operations.
Confirmed: Python SDK v0.8.3 retry middleware will re-issue the request body on retry; no automatic idempotency key generation for function calls in these SDK versions.
Streaming reconnect path in TS SDK v0.9.0 replays the last outbound message during reconnect without attaching stable correlation id by default.

Observed: Gateway honors 'X-Redwood-Idempotency' header for REST/sync flows and will de-duplicate within a 30s sliding window if the header is present. Streaming path has inconsistent enforcement due to reconnect reassembly logic.
resolution: Short-term workaround: Customer added an application-generated stable idempotency token (transaction_id) to each logical operation and included it both as 'X-Redwood-Idempotency' header and inside the function_call payload. Additionally, they implemented a server-side dedupe check at billing-service keyed on transaction_id. This prevented duplicate invoices.

Recommended SDK upgrade: Upgrade Python SDK to v0.9.1+ or Typescript SDK to v0.10.0+ once released; these versions include middleware to auto-add 'X-Redwood-Idempotency' when user supplies 'idempotencyKey' parameter on the client call and improved streaming reconnect semantics.

Product follow-up: Filed internal ticket INT-412 to add consistent dedupe support for function_call replay on streaming reconnects and to extend gateway de-dup window to 2 minutes for high-risk endpoints.
Docs action: Add a new support doc and examples for 'Exactly-once patterns for function calling' in the developer docs and quickstart samples for Python/TS/Go.
Status: customer confirmed workaround in staging; awaiting SDK release timeline.
